decision: Dispatch issues 15/16/17/19/20 as a three-wave swarm cohort with a stop-at: pr-open worker envelope and a parent-retained merge path

governingRule.description: Envelope selection SLA (#3153): drive-to: merge-ready is the default story envelope; a deliberate stop-at: pr-open requires a named partner merge-path owner

alternativesConsidered.option: drive-to: merge-ready leaves owning the full path through merge -- impossible here, the only authorized account (dbcall2) is EMU-blocked on gh pr merge and gh pr comment, so a worker would exit thin DONE by construction
All five dispatched in parallel -- swarm:readiness puts 15, 16 and 20 in one conflict group on curriculum/modules/06, solutions/module-06 and scripts/verify-module-6.*
Serialize all five as sequential solo workers -- 17 and 19 share no files with the module-06 group, so serializing them costs three round trips for nothing

whyWinner: swarm:readiness derives waves 1={16,17,19}, 2={20}, 3={15} from declared file_scope, matching the operator-approved plan; stop-at: pr-open is the only envelope a worker can complete, with the parent conversation as named merge-path owner and the human performing merges
revisitTrigger: dbcall2 regains PR merge and comment rights, or a non-EMU account is authorized for this repo -- then the default drive-to: merge-ready envelope applies again
